title: questions collection document
description: Mutable cross-survey identity of one question. The document is only the stable handle: content lives in immutable question_versions documents, and latest_version_id points at the newest one. Semantic invariants (checked by the service): latest_version_id belongs to this entity; latest_version_no and version_count match the version history; root_entity_id is the start of the fork lineage; a question referenced by any published survey version may only be soft-deleted. Visibility private means owner only, shared adds explicit question_shares grants, and public is usable by any signed-in user.

owner_id.description: Owner; only the owner may edit, share or delete the question.

root_entity_id.description: Lineage root (itself, or the start of the fork chain), used to query the whole family of questions.

source_entity_id.description: Question this one was forked from; null for an original question.

source_version_id.description: Source version the fork was based on; null when there is no source.

lineage_depth.description: Fork generation; 0 for an original question.

type.description: Redundant copy of the latest version's type so that list filtering does not need to read versions.

title.description: Redundant copy of the latest version's title, kept in sync when a new version is created.

visibility.description: private is owner-only; shared also grants the users listed in question_shares; public is usable by any signed-in user.

latest_version_id.description: Pointer to the newest question_versions document.

latest_version_no.description: Redundant latest version number, used for sorting and display.

version_count.description: Total number of versions; equal to latest_version_no in normal operation.

deleted_at.description: Soft-delete marker; published references and responses keep the question readable.
